assay: bulk 3' mRNA-seq (Lexogen QuantSeq FWD), gastrocnemius, NextSeq500 75bp SE (S4.6.p1); GEO: STAR mm10 + htseq-count
sample_inclusion: muscle-specific Pex5 KO (MLC1f-Cre; Pex5 f/f) vs Cre-negative littermates, 3/9/18 months, mixed sex (S4.1.p1, S2.3.p1)

factors.name: age
factors.note: each age deposited and analysed as its own sub-series

exercise_arm: Treadmill run to exhaustion at 3 and 18 months (S4.3.p1, S2.5.p3, FIG5K) measured running distance only; no exercised or sedentary muscle was sequenced. GEO samples carry only tissue, age and genotype.
primary_estimand: RNA-seq estimand: effect of muscle Pex5 deletion on the gastrocnemius transcriptome at each age (KO vs age-matched control). Exercise effect on gene expression is not an RNA-seq estimand in this paper.

blocking_or_covariance.note: one muscle per mouse, between-animal arms; sex mixed, not modelled in the paper

paper_method: DESeq2 1.42.0 Wald test, BH, genes with <10 counts across samples prefiltered (S4.6.p2)

reported_counts.GSE263103_3mo: 30 inhibited (down) DEGs used for GOEA (S4.6.p4); up count not reported

enrichment.method: GSEA MSigDB v7.0 C5 BP/CC, FDR<0.25 (S4.6.p3); DAVID GOEA on down genes, FDR<10%, ES>1.5 (S4.6.p4)
